caption: The drawing features two objects set against a plain, light beige background. On the left, there is a rectangular, rusted metal container with a rounded handle on top. The container has embossed text reading "OSTARR" and the number "2" beneath it. Its surface shows variations in color, primarily rusty browns with patches of blue-gray and spots of lighter corrosion. On the right is a cone-shaped metal funnel, also showing signs of rust and age with a brown, weathered appearance. The funnel is lying on its side with its wide opening facing the viewer, and a metal rod or handle is visible inside. Both objects are placed apart from each other with no additional elements or background details in the composition. The artist's signature, “Dorothy Beeman,” appears faintly in the lower right corner.
title: Cow Bell
